title: “newer” mallworld?
content: has anyone experienced a sudden pause in their mallworld dreams, only to be met with a completely new mallworld? my mallworld has updated twice before— the first time was DEFINITELY more seventies…. second time was 80’s…, i feel like im progressing in time in them. currently stuck in the bloomington MOA in my dreams, complete with the raddison attached to it. i guess its a little more fun than the last mall but… i kind of miss it. 💔 just wanted to see if anyone’s map updated over the past 2 weeks like mine did. if the pictures i’ve been seeing are any evidence, something changed for sure.
